What We Offer

Our Services

Every service is performed with precision, care, and an unwavering commitment to quality.

01
Signature Fade

Our most sought-after service. A flawless taper or skin fade tailored to your head shape and preferred style — clean lines, sharp edges.

From LKR 1,500 / session
02
Precision Cut

Classic scissor or clipper cut with detailed finishing. Perfect for those who value consistency and a timeless, polished look every visit.

From LKR 1,200 / session
03
Beard Sculpt

Hot towel prep, precision trim, shape-up, and skin detailing. Your beard deserves the same attention as your hair.

From LKR 800 / session
04
Hair Colour

Full colour, highlights, or toning — applied with expert technique and premium products for vivid, lasting results.

From LKR 3,500 / session
05
Scalp Treatment

Hydrating and strengthening scalp ritual using professional-grade serums. A luxury experience that promotes healthy hair growth.

From LKR 2,200 / session
06
Grooming Package

Cut + beard + wash + style. Our signature end-to-end grooming ritual for the client who wants the full experience in one sitting.

From LKR 3,000 / session

Our Story

About Liyoni

Salon Liyoni was founded with a single purpose — to bring world-class grooming to Sri Lanka. Located in the heart of Colombo, we have spent over eight years crafting an experience that goes beyond the chair.

We blend international technique with an intimate, personalised approach. Whether you're after your weekly fade or a complete style transformation, every visit is treated with the same level of craft and care.

Trained professionals — our stylists are certified and continuously trained on the latest techniques from the UK and UAE.
Premium products only — we exclusively use internationally recognised grooming brands for every service.
Hygiene guaranteed — all tools are sterilised between each client, every time, no exceptions.
